title: Make agent-session prompt addendum behavior truthful and enforced
description:
Problem: the agent-session interface accepts and stores a system prompt addendum, but invocation requests do not apply it. Callers can therefore receive a successful-looking session configuration while the requested behavior has no effect.

Desired outcome: the public contract either applies the addendum through the model request pipeline with policy controls or rejects the parameter until support exists.

Scope:
- Choose and document implement-versus-reject behavior.
- If implemented, carry the addendum into invocation context, enforce length/content/profile policy, and preserve decision provenance.
- If deferred, remove it from the advertised schema or return a clear unsupported response.
- Add end-to-end tests proving the selected contract.
- Out of scope: general prompt authoring or model-quality tuning.

Acceptance criteria:
- A caller cannot silently provide an ineffective addendum.
- Implemented addenda are visible at the intended invocation boundary and are subject to authorization and size limits.
- Deferred behavior is explicit, stable, and covered by a contract test.
- Documentation and schema text match runtime behavior.

Validation:
- Run focused agent-session and chat request contract tests.
- Run the application build.
- Run Test-TaskRecords.ps1 after task metadata changes.
